title: Associative source-handle preflight inventory
scope: Include the source-format-selected associative object records in dx_iface's shared extension-graph source identity inventory. Reject unaddressable, duplicate, and cross-family-colliding associative handles before graph planning. This is preflight identity validation only; it does not reserve writer handles, serialize associative objects, or qualify document conversion.

implementationEvidence.result: DWG associativeObjects and DXF associativeObjects are checked in the shared source handle namespace. Zero, DRW::NoHandle, repeated associative handles, and aliases with LTYPE or DICTIONARY handles fail with InvalidGraph. Unique identities in both source formats pass preflight.

validation.result: PASS; 1/1 focused fast selector covering unique DWG/DXF handles, zero and sentinel rejection, duplicate handles, and LTYPE/DICTIONARY collisions

implementationEvidence.fixturePolicy: All records are authored in memory; no DWG/DXF fixtures were added.

remaining: Reserve associative identities in the DXF writer before generated allocation, map source to planned to emitted handles, and route admitted writers through the recursive graph planner. Independent staged-output field inspection/readback and atomic publication/retry proof remain open under P4.
